findings.text: non-blocking: the three _verify_*_claim_winners helpers (1231, 1333, 1354) and claim_enrich_parents_batch (graph_parent_lifecycle.py:303) are the only four moved definitions that are not a pure move; they replace import-time defaults (settle_seconds=_CLAIM_VERIFY_SETTLE_SECONDS, batch_size=DEFAULT_POOL_BATCH_SIZE) with None sentinels resolved per call from services, so the announced default changes to None, an explicit None argument is now silently defaulted instead of propagated, and each default became patch-sensitive where the base bound it at import.

non-blocking: 12 test files that patch a moved symbol through the attribute-string form (monkeypatch.setattr(graph_ops, "<name>", ...) or patch.object(graph_ops, "<name>", ...)) are outside the 33-file gate, because the design's patch_targets.test_files_by_module scan records only dotted graph_ops.<name> literals; the node followed the brief and the design exactly, and the exposure is contained because every intra-module call in the four new modules routes through services (zero bare same-module calls), so the facade patch targets still bind.
